messages:
Alex C: Quick poll — who can own the token-attribution dry-run this week? Need final owners, test window, and smoke-test checklist. target: Friday EOD.
Ria M: I can take lead on the dry-run coordination. I'll own the smoke tests and runbooks. Can someone own infra readiness? @Samir?
Samir: I can handle infra readiness (queues, ingestion shims). ETA Thu morning for env prep. Will drop a checklist later.
Tarun K: I'll do the schema validation + sampler for latency breakdowns. Need perms to run event replays on staging. @Alex C can you grant?
Alex C: Granting access now. Also adding :calendar: to lock Friday 10–12 PT for the smoke window.
Olivia P: Heads-up — billing team wants a quick readout after the run. I'll prep a 1-slide cost delta summary (tokens/3 models) and join postmortem.
Samir: infra checklist (WIP):
```
- deploy ingest-shim v2
- enable debug logging
- stand up 2 staging workers
- run replay with 5k reqs
```
Tarun K: For latency breakdown, I'll push a small agent that tags spans with model_variant + quantization flag.
Ria M: Can we add a rollback plan in case the run trips prod SLOs? suggestion: immediate fallback to cached responses + notify oncall.
Alex C: yes — plan is: (1) abort run, (2) flip routing to cached_model, (3) page oncall. @deploy-bot can you add that to the runbook?
deploy-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-attrib-dryrun
Olivia P: Cool. Last ask — who owns the cross-team signoff? We need infra, product, and billing. I nominate Ria + Samir + Olivia.
Ria M: Fine with that. I'll kick off an async sign-off thread after smoke test.
Alex C: Great. I'll create the PR for the sampling config and tag reviewers. Thanks all :rocket:
